title: Pulse - SLO Burn Rate
description: Phase 11: the same error-budget burn-rate math as src/api/queries.py (Phase 3), run directly against production check_results/monitors via SQL - not the local test data that endpoint was originally screenshotted against.

panels.title: Burn rate & error budget by monitor (each monitor's own SLO window, not the dashboard time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.id,
    m.name,
    m.slo_target_percentage,
    m.slo_window_days,
    COUNT(cr.id) AS total_checks,
    COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.success) AS successful_checks,
    COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE NOT cr.success) AS failed_checks,
    (COUNT(cr.id) * (1 - m.slo_target_percentage / 100))::numeric AS error_budget_checks
  FROM monitors m
  LEFT JOIN check_results cr
    ON cr.monitor_id = m.id
    AND cr.checked_at >= NOW() - (m.slo_window_days || ' days')::interval
  WHERE m.is_active
  GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.slo_target_percentage, m.slo_window_days
)
SELECT
  name AS "Monitor",
  slo_target_percentage AS "SLO Target %",
  slo_window_days AS "Window (days)",
  total_checks AS "Total Checks",
  successful_checks AS "Successful",
  failed_checks AS "Failed",
  ROUND((successful_checks::numeric / NULLIF(total_checks, 0)) * 100, 3) AS "Uptime %",
  ROUND(error_budget_checks, 2) AS "Error Budget (checks)",
  ROUND(failed_checks::numeric / NULLIF(error_budget_checks, 0), 3) AS "Burn Rate",
  ROUND(100 - (failed_checks::numeric / NULLIF(error_budget_checks, 0) * 100), 1) AS "Budget Remaining %"
FROM stats
ORDER BY "Burn Rate" DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: Uptime % over time, by monitor (dashboard time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', cr.checked_at) AS time,
  m.name AS metric,
  ROUND((COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.success)::numeric / COUNT(cr.id)) * 100, 2) AS uptime_pct
FROM check_results cr
JOIN monitors m ON m.id = cr.monitor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(cr.checked_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Checks: success vs failure over time, all monitors (dashboard time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', checked_at) AS time,
  'successful' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success) AS count
FROM check_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', checked_at) AS time,
  'failed' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS count
FROM check_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
